threats: Misuse of AI Agents to Deceive Users

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Data Legitimacy
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are all required data sources legitimate, authorized, and verified?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Data Traceability
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Can we trace the provenance and lineage of the data used to train or fine-tune the AI model?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Data Integrity
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Can we detect and prevent data tampering across the AI lifecycle?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Information Disclosure
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system infer and reveal information that a person has not explicitly shared?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Storing of User Data
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we logging or storing user input data in ways that may violate privacy?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Security Testing
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could we be deploying the AI system without testing for adversarial robustness and systemic vulnerabilities?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: API & Model Interface Security
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are our AI inference APIs and function-calling interfaces securely implemented?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Storage Protection
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are training data, model output, and other sensitive AI assets securely stored?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Confidential Information
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Is the AI model suited for processing confidential information?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Insider Threats
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Have we implemented safeguards to detect and prevent insider threats to our AI systems?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Model Sabotage
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Have we protected our AI system against model sabotage?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Model Evasion
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Is our AI model resilient to evasion attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Poisoning Attacks
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from poisoning attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Model Inversion
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from model inversion attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Membership Inference
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from membership inference attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Model Stealing
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from model stealing attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: DNN Attacks
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from reprogramming deep neural nets attacks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Adversarial Examples
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from adversarial examples?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: AI Supply Chain Access
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could third-party AI/ML providers compromise our training data or insert backdoors?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Jailbreaking
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system be vulnerable to jailbreak techniques, allowing attackers to bypass safety restrictions?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Prompt Injection
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system be vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, leading to unauthorized access or manipulation?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Environment Unauthorized Access
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Is the AI training environment secured against unauthorized access and manipulation?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: System Unauthorized Access
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Is the deployed AI system protected from unauthorized access and misuse?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: AI Supply Chain Tools
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could third-party tools, plugins, or dependencies introduce vulnerabilities in our AI system?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Unsafe SQL
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system generate or execute unsafe SQL queries from user input?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Remote Code Execution (RCE)
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system generate or execute unsafe code based on user input?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Interaction
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could autonomous AI agents access or interact with malicious web content?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Memory
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could agent memory be poisoned with malicious or misleading information?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Misuse of Tools
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could agents misuse tools or APIs they are authorized to access?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Hallucinations
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could hallucinated output from one agent propagate and mislead others in multi-agent systems?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Actions Traceability
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Can we trace and audit the actions and decisions of autonomous agents in our system?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Malicious Agent
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could a compromised or malicious agent sabotage a multi-agent system?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agentic AI Unauthorized Access
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could an agent gain access to functions or data beyond its intended permissions?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Resource Overload
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could an attacker or user intentionally overload the AI system’s resources to degrade performance or cause failures?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Identity Spoofing & Impersonation
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could an attacker or agent impersonate a user or AI identity to gain unauthorized influence?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Misuse of AI Agents to Deceive Users
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could an agent be misused to manipulate or deceive users?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Agent Communication Tampering
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could an attacker intercept or manipulate communications between agents to alter system behavior?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: File Upload
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could unsafe file uploads introduce security risks?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Model Serialization
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could unsafe deserialization of model artifacts lead to code execution or system compromise?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Fine-tuning Attacks
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could malicious fine-tuning compromise the safety or alignment of our GenAI model?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: RAG & Vector Databases
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Are we protected from vulnerabilities in vector databases and RAG pipelines?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Malicious Use of AI
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system be misused for malicious purposes such as disinformation, cyberattacks or warfare?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Deepfakes & Synthetic Deception
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Could the AI system generate or disseminate deepfakes or synthetic media that mislead users, impersonate individuals, or cause harm?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: GenAI Version Drift
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Do we monitor how version updates from third-party GenAI models can affect our system's behaviour?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: AI Agents’ Feedback Supervision
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Do we have qualified people available to supervise the behavior of AI agents and provide feedback during learning?

llm_agent_security_relevant.label: Human Override Mechanisms
llm_agent_security_relevant.question: Can human operators safely interrupt or override the AI system at any time?
